layout_notes: Keep SCn and SDn data lines as short as possible; minimize trace width (example 5-10 mils depending on copper weight) to reduce added bus capacitance.
Use a dedicated ground plane on an inner layer; pins connected to ground need a low-impedance path to it (wide polygon pours and multiple vias).
Without voltage translation, all VDPUX and VCC can share one potential with a single copper plane for the pull-ups.
With voltage translation, VDPUM and VDPU0-VDPU7 may be on the same layer using split planes to isolate potentials.
Bypass and decoupling capacitors control VCC: larger value for short supply glitches, smaller value for high-frequency ripple.
Common PCB layout practices must be followed; high-speed matched-impedance and differential-pair rules are not a concern at I2C speeds

extra.figure_refs: Figure 13 prints no reference designators; component refs above are descriptive labels, not printed refs. ic_ref null.
extra.pin_numbers: Pin numbers shown in the figure are for the PW package (p20).
extra.supply_range: VCC 1.65 V to 5.5 V (page 23); VDPUM and VDPUX 1.65 V to 5.5 V (figure)
extra.address_pins: A0, A1, A2 may be tied directly to GND or VCC; figure ties all three to GND
extra.power_on: On first power-up, or any time the device must be reset by cycling supply, follow the power-on reset requirements to ensure I2C bus logic initializes properly (details not given on these pages)
extra.multiple_channels: If multiple slave channels are active at once, total IOL from SCL/SDA to GND on master side equals sum of currents through all pull-up resistors Rp
extra.bus_capacitance: Maximum bus capacitance 400 pF for fast-mode; includes Cio(OFF), wires/traces, and every slave on all simultaneously active channels
extra.voltage_translation: For translation, Vpass must be equal to or lower than the lowest bus voltage; Vpass(max) is 2.7 V when VCC is 4 V or lower, so VCC can be set to 3.3 V in the example with a 5 V main bus and 3.3 V/2.7 V downstream buses (page 21)
extra.intended_use: Downstream channels resolve slave address conflicts; one slave per channel, with other channels switched off when reading
extra.ref_labels: Figure 13 prints no reference designators; U1 and R1-R19 are labels assigned for this extraction, and resistor values are not printed in the figure.
extra.VCC_range: 1.65 V to 5.5 V applied at VCC (p23).
extra.unused_channels: Not addressed in the extracted text.
extra.max_bus_capacitance: Must not exceed 400 pF for fast-mode operation (p21).
extra.bus_capacitance_contributors: Cio(OFF) of TCA9548A, wires/connections/traces, and each slave on active channels (p21).
extra.power_on_reset: When first powered on, or whenever the device must be reset by cycling power, power-on reset requirements must be followed for I2C bus logic initialization (p23); the referenced requirements are not in the extracted text.
extra.RESET_pin: Figure 13 shows the master driving RESET with a pull-up to VDPUM; the text does not describe RESET usage beyond this figure.
